name: thedaw-desktop
description: theDAW desktop shell: an Electron front end that bootstraps and supervises the Python audio backend.
author: GANTASMO

scripts.dist:win: npm run fetch:tools && npm run fetch:vj && npm run fetch:foundry && npm run fetch:sway && npm run fetch:notation && npm run stage:vst-host && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win

scripts.dist:win:ci: npm run fetch:tools && npm run fetch:vj && npm run fetch:foundry && npm run fetch:sway && npm run fetch:notation && npm run stage:vst-host && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:ci: npm run fetch:tools && npm run fetch:vj && npm run fetch:foundry && npm run fetch:sway && npm run fetch:notation && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
